name: Alaska
overview: State law requires specified municipal homestead exemptions and permits additional local exemptions.

programs.name: Senior citizen and disabled veteran exemption
programs.ageRule: Age 65+ or qualifying disabled veteran; surviving-spouse provisions apply.
programs.incomeDefinition: Mandatory exemption is not described as income-tested.
programs.incomeLimits: No income limit for the mandatory base exemption.
programs.formulaSummary: Municipal tax applies after the mandatory assessed-value exemption.
programs.application: Apply to the municipal assessor by its local deadline.
eligibilityNotes: Disabled veteran must have at least 50% service-connected disability.
Municipalities may adopt additional exemptions by ordinance.

sources.title: Property tax exemptions in Alaska — DCRA

researchNotes: No statewide cash property-tax or renter credit identified. Optional municipal relief is not a uniform statewide credit.
